topic: A checkout only its remote places gets no space's rules
detail: After the security audit (H-1), a checkout gets a space's rules only when its folder root decided the placement; a job repo cloned under a personal root gets a checkout-with-no-space's rules (no GH_CONFIG_DIR, no TMPDIR). Options: keep (move such clones under the job's root); or let the operator pin a checkout to a space.
